status: registered before data inspection (download in progress)
purpose: G0 gate of PLAN_GROUNDED_CHANGE_MEMORY_2026_09_22: does SpaceNet 7 actually contain the phenomena the paper is about — partial occlusion (UDM-flagged unusable pixels), irregular usable-observation gaps, and change events whose neighbouring months are occluded?
data: SpaceNet 7 train tarball (60 AOIs, ~24 monthly Planet mosaics each, UDM_masks/*.tif, labels_match/*.geojson with persistent building ids).
measurements: per AOI x month: fraction of pixels flagged unusable in UDM (value != 0)
per AOI: number of months with unusable fraction > .2 (partially occluded) and > .5 (mostly occluded); longest run of consecutive occluded months
per AOI: months missing from the mosaic sequence
change events: buildings whose id first appears in labels_match at month t (t>0); for each, unusable fraction over the building footprint (buffer 2 px) at t-1, t, t+1
aggregate: fraction of change events with at least one of {t-1,t,t+1} having footprint unusable fraction > .5

gate.phenomenon_present: fraction of change events with occluded neighbour month >= .15 AND at least 20 AOIs have >= 2 partially occluded months
gate.reading_if_fail: SpaceNet 7 supports the change-memory question but NOT the observed-vs-apparent-change axis; drop that axis from the title for the SN7 experiments and rely on the S2 long series for occlusion

not_a_claim: this audits data, not any model
code: code/sn7_occlusion_audit_v0.py (written before data arrives; probed on one AOI first)
